title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-27
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑70s Family Dog show, highlighted by a monster Lovelight and solid performances throughout.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality, often described as A+ or a 9/10 rating, with only minor vocal/high‑hat balance quirks. Musically the concert shines on the 26‑minute Lovelight, plus strong renditions of Good Lovin', Easy Wind, Hard to Handle and Dancin', though a few reviewers note occasional early‑70s sloppiness. Overall fans consider this one of the standout Family Dog dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4‑5) and repeated praise for both the superb soundboard recording and the standout performances, especially Lovelight.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with A+ sound; a few comments about vocal/high‑hat levels being slightly off but overall very solid for a 1970 recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑70s Family Dog energy with some marked sloppiness, but the long Lovelight jam and tight rhythm section keep the momentum high; overall a strong, if occasionally routine, performance.

band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly praised for phenomenal bass work – 'phenominal', 'thumps away', and providing unbelievable harmony.
